def _handle_enum(self, node, scope, ctxt, stream):
        """Handle enum nodes

        :node: TODO
        :scope: TODO
        :ctxt: TODO
        :stream: TODO
        :returns: TODO

        """
        name = node.name
        scope = scope.get_type(name)
        if scope is None:
            scope = ctxt.new_type(name)
        stream.write('typedef enum {')
        for i in node.items:
            self.handle_enum_item(i, scope, ctxt, stream)
        stream.write('} %s;' % (name))
        self.handle_comments(node.comments, stream)
